title: Fault-inject every turn boundary
description:
Build deterministic failure scenarios around message commit, logical enqueue, worker claim, model acceptance, progress append, completion append, acknowledgement, and deadline recovery.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each before-and-after crash window has an executable scenario.
- Scenarios assert provider call counts, final channel messages, current attempt, and terminal state.
- No scenario permits two authoritative actors.
- The suite completes without real provider calls or sleeps.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kernel on develop and main: python/tests/test_turn_fault_injection.py parametrizes ALL_CRASH_SCENARIOS (before/after every TurnBoundary including deadline recovery). No two authoritative actors. Suite uses in-memory driver; no real provider or sleeps.
